# AppBlocks Web — compact model instructions

AppBlocks Web is an indentation DSL that compiles to complete HTML/CSS/JS sites. Output AppBlocks, not HTML, JSX, CSS or JavaScript.

SYNTAX
- Use exactly two spaces per nesting level. Never use tabs.
- A line begins with a lowercase block name.
- Quoted positional text follows the name: title "Know where every dollar goes"
- Configuration uses key=value: hero variant=split reveal=true
- Values may be quoted strings, bare strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays or simple objects.
- Comments begin with # only when # appears outside quotes after whitespace.

REQUIRED SHAPE
site "Project name" theme=blueprint lang=en base=/
  meta description="Concrete project description"
  header logo="Project name"
    nav
      link "Product" href="/#product"
    button "Primary action" href=/start variant=solid
  footer logo="Project name"
  page "/" title="Specific page title"
    hero variant=split
      eyebrow "Specific context"
      title "Concrete promise" level=1
      text "Useful explanation"
      button "Specific action" href=/start variant=solid

AUTHORING POLICY
1. Choose the largest semantic block that matches the outcome.
2. Use marketing blocks for persuasion, application blocks for repeated tasks, reading blocks for documentation and layout blocks only for real exceptions.
3. Put one level=1 title on every page.
4. Give every field a visible label and every image an alt attribute. Use alt="" only for decorative images.
5. Use links for destinations and buttons for actions.
6. Never use raw HTML, inline JavaScript or javascript:/data: URLs.
7. Do not fabricate testimonials, metrics, logos, customers, certifications or backend results. Mark demonstration data clearly.
8. Prefer shared header/footer under site instead of repeating them per page. Use page layout=app to omit shared chrome for application shells.
9. Query contracts instead of guessing: appblocks catalog <name-or-family> --json
10. Validate strictly and repair every diagnostic: appblocks validate file.appblocks --strict --json

CORE FAMILIES
- navigation: header nav link button breadcrumbs footer
- marketing: hero visual proof logos stats features split steps testimonials pricing comparison faq cta newsletter gallery timeline
- application: app-shell sidebar toolbar metrics chart table form tabs panel dialog kanban activity empty-state status catalog
- reading: article prose callout code-block quote list
- layout: section grid stack columns divider spacer
- content: eyebrow title heading text badge tag icon image code item

WORKFLOW
1. Plan routes and each route's job.
2. Retrieve only relevant block manifests.
3. Write one coherent .appblocks file.
4. Run strict validation.
5. Build and inspect the generated site at desktop and mobile widths.
6. Change the AppBlocks source, not generated files, unless implementing a documented escape hatch.
